_comment: Sex/masturbation actions (D-190). Each is a composable act: category → action → target role (+ an optional supporting action). `plays_to` names a preference topic it favours; `topics` are tags it satisfies. `supporting` acts can run alongside a primary. Weighting is automatic from preferences/arousal/personality.

actions.line: Her fingers work herself with a familiar patience.

actions.line: A broad, wet stroke of the tongue, testing.

actions.label: Suckling
actions.line: She draws on her own chest and something answers.

actions.line: Instinct takes over; she mounts and sets a rhythm.

actions.label: Held breathing
actions.line: She slows her breathing and rides the edge instead of chasing it.
